messages:
Alicia (partnerships): Heads up — HW partner asked if we can stack their OEM credit with our marketplace private-offer discount for a pilot account. They want clarity before the joint announcement next month.
Sam (sales): Stacking is fine from a sales perspective but we need to map SKUs exactly so usage credit vs reserved commit doesn't double-count.
Raj (hw-partner): Correct — our credit would be applied at invoice as an SKU-level rebate. We can add a 'redwood_oem_credit' tag on their invoice metadata.
Maria (revops): Tagging invoices is fine, but marketplace private offers apply at checkout. We need a mapping table: marketplace SKU -> invoice SKU -> credit application rule.
Ethan (legal): Also confirm: if we allow stacking, we should capture a clause that credits cannot be used to meet minimum committed spend thresholds for renewals. Otherwise customers could game committed discounts.
Alicia (partnerships): Good point. Proposal: allow stacking for consumption (pay-as-you-go) and for committed offers only allow one credit source to count toward the commit floor. Maria, can you draft the mapping + commit rule?
Maria (revops): On it. I'll create a spreadsheet with columns: marketplace_sku, provider_sku, credit_source, credit_applies_to_commit (yes/no), notes. ETA EOD Thu.
Sam (sales): From buyer messaging POV, we should surface this as "hardware partner credit stacks with Redwood consumption discounts; committed capacity discounts apply separately" — short and clear.
Raj (hw-partner): Is there any operational blocker for us tagging invoices? We pull billing CSVs weekly.
Maria (revops): No blocker. We just need the exact field name. Raj, can you confirm the invoice metadata key?
Raj (hw-partner): We'll use invoice_meta.oem_credit_id.
Ethan (legal): I'll draft the short contract addendum that says: "OEM credits and Marketplace private-offer discounts may be combined for consumption billing. For committed spend calculations and renewal entitlements, only one external partner credit may be applied toward meeting committed volume thresholds." Keep it 2-3 sentences.
Alicia (partnerships): Thanks. Also, this affects the renewal playbook — if credit doesn't count toward commit, renewal offers need to account for the apparent usage delta. Sam, we should avoid surprises in QBRs.
Sam (sales): Agreed. Recommend 30-day renewal visibility flag on accounts using stacked credits so AMs get a heads-up and we can propose true-up offers.
Maria (revops): I can add a boolean flag in our billing export: stacked_credit=true and a 30d_renewal_alert tag. Will add to mapping sheet.
Alicia (partnerships): On the announcement side: marketing wants one joint blog + customer case study. Raj, your comms team needs the cadence: legal + revops signoff by next Tue, PR draft by next Fri, announcement target date = 2026-01-20.
Raj (hw-partner): We'll aim for signoff. Can you confirm the announcement will not promise guaranteed discounts beyond pilot?
Alicia (partnerships): Correct — pilot only. We'll include a line: "discounts subject to partner program terms and commit thresholds."
Sam (sales): One operational ask: for private offers we create in each marketplace (AWS/GCP/Azure), ensure pricing JSON includes a metadata field: "external_credit_applicable": ["oem", "spend_commit"]. That way we can filter offers that allow stacking.
Maria (revops): Good call. I'll add that to the implementation notes.
Ethan (legal): Also note export control / compliance check for hardware partner customers in GovCloud — we should add a clause about region-specific eligibility.
Alicia (partnerships): Noted. Raj, can you confirm whether your OEM credit applies globally or excludes Gov/Secret regions?
Raj (hw-partner): Excludes Gov/Secret. We'll send a short eligibility list.
Alicia (partnerships): Action items recap: Maria — mapping sheet + add billing flags (ETA EOD Thu). Ethan — contract addendum draft (ETA Mon). Raj — confirm invoice_meta key and eligibility list (ETA Wed). Sam — messaging snippet for AMs + renewal playbook updates (ETA Tue). I'll coordinate PR timeline.
deploy-bot: Reminder: #legal-signoff checklist created -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PR-9876
Alicia (partnerships): Thanks team. We'll sync 1:1 with Raj later today to lock wording for partners.
Sam (sales): :thumbsup:
Maria (revops): Sending sheet link in a follow-up thread.
Ethan (legal): Will ping when the addendum is ready for review.
Raj (hw-partner): Thanks all. We'll align on our side and send the eligibility doc by EOD Wed.
Alicia (partnerships): Closing loop here — please post any changes to the spreadsheet so AMs don't get out of sync.
